title: Dutch junction design - safer for cyclists
summary: A short BicycleDutch episode showing how Dutch junctions with protected cycle paths are laid out. It argues these are proven, non-experimental designs that make intersections safer for cyclists.
why: Linked as the go-to demonstration that the cyclist-versus-driver conflict at intersections is a solved design problem.

quote.text: Well guess what, we've figured this out decades ago in the Netherlands
